Where Is the Nearest Liquor Store in Murfreesboro?

The nearest full-service liquor store for most of Murfreesboro is Liquor & Wine Outlet at 2003 SE Broad Street — central to the city, accessible from I-24 (Exit 81), and just minutes from MTSU, downtown, and the Stones River Mall area. Use the map below for live directions.

Our Selection

What Does Liquor & Wine Outlet Sell?

A full-store curated selection in one stop at 2003 SE Broad Street. Browse the categories below or visit in person to see the shelves.

Fine Wines

Location FAQs

Finding Liquor & Wine Outlet

Common questions about location, directions, and parking.

Liquor & Wine Outlet is at 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN 37130 — on Highway 41/70S (SE Broad Street) near the Stones River Mall area. Search "Liquor & Wine Outlet Murfreesboro" on Google Maps or use the embedded map on this page. Call (615) 624-6928 if you need turn-by-turn help.

From I-24 East, take Exit 81B (US-231 / Church Street) toward Murfreesboro, continue south on Church Street, then east on Mercury Boulevard to SE Broad Street (Highway 41/70S). Turn south on SE Broad Street — Liquor & Wine Outlet is at 2003 SE Broad Street. The drive from I-24 is roughly 5 to 8 minutes depending on traffic.

Liquor & Wine Outlet is on SE Broad Street near the Stones River Mall shopping district. Common landmarks nearby include Middle Tennessee State University (MTSU) approximately 2 miles northwest, Stones River National Battlefield approximately 2.5 miles northeast, the Avenue Murfreesboro shopping center, and the historic Murfreesboro Square downtown approximately 1.5 miles north.

Yes — free parking is available directly in front of Liquor & Wine Outlet at 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN, with additional spaces in the adjacent shopping center lot. The store is wheelchair accessible and ADA parking spots are nearby.

Liquor & Wine Outlet at 2003 SE Broad Street is approximately 2 miles southeast of Middle Tennessee State University (MTSU). The drive typically takes 5 to 7 minutes via SE Broad Street (Highway 41/70S). Easy walking distance from nearby off-campus housing along Broad Street.

Liquor & Wine Outlet is open Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Call (615) 624-6928 before driving over on a holiday to confirm hours.
